title: Contributions to the change in the NEET rate aged 16-24, 2019 to 2026 Q2
source: ONS Young people not in education, employment or training (NEET) table 1, seasonally adjusted; ukmacro calculations
note: Groups: men and women aged 16-17 and 18-24. Base = 2019 average. Midpoint weights, so the parts add up to the total change. The within-group part splits exactly into unemployed and economically inactive NEETs, except in quarters where ONS suppressed one part (grey). Within-group contributions only, by group.
